The opening presents human service work in a world already rich in digital assistance. Theodore writes letters for clients, while an advertised consumer operating system is introduced as an artificial consciousness. The relevant contrast is that capable AI enters daily life without the story first establishing an economy where human work has ceased to matter. That makes this a limited zero-variant reference.

The guarantee best guess places ordinary life somewhat toward purchase-dependent insecurity, with a wide interval because a consumer story does not explain public benefits. Human institutions and buyers still have influence, while independent AI agency complicates control. The modest nonworking estimate retains professions, care and informal contribution despite digital task substitution. It is not derived from one employed protagonist or commuters. This remains an interpretive zero variant before the AIs leave, rather than a fully demonstrated post-work economy. Their later departure is a different technical situation, and no guaranteed outcome for displaced workers or universal ownership of AI services is invented.
